request: Owner request: find code and assets that are no longer needed, rank them in three tiers — delete the obvious ones, have another agent deep-review the second tier, and submit the third to the owner.
method: Every tracked source module checked for an importer; every tracked asset in public/ and docs/ checked for a reference; every dependency checked for a use; every CSS custom property and class checked against the components.

ESLint runs @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars at --max-warnings 0, so unused locals and imports cannot reach a commit. That is why the search found so little: the category is already fenced off, and only unused exports could linger.
The second tier went to an independent review agent with a read-only brief: verdict, evidence inspected, risk, reasoning per item.

tier1_deleted.what: 46 KB of Chromium network-notifier noise from Playwright runs between 2026-09-02 and 2026-09-16.
tier1_deleted.safe: Gitignored, written by the browser, regenerated on demand.
Gitignored, regenerated by the next run.

tier1_deleted.what: 48 MB production build from 2026-09-19 13:34, predating the boat marks, dictation and evaluation-note work.
tier1_deleted.safe: Gitignored and reproducible with `npm run build`. It was also actively misleading: `npm run preview` and `npm run check:ocr-offline` serve dist/ without rebuilding, which is the stale-build hazard CLAUDE.md warns about on ports 4173 and 4174, reproduced on 4175.

acted.item: tsconfig.app.json and tsconfig.node.json lacked noUnusedLocals and noUnusedParameters
acted.evidence: Both projects compile clean with the flags on. They add what ESLint does not catch — unused private class members — and move the failure into `typecheck` as well as `lint`. They do not report unused exports, so they would not have caught a single symbol from the export list below.

acted.item: Intl.Collator constructed inside the comparator body in src/domain/evaluations.ts
acted.evidence: One collator allocated per comparison, O(n log n) per sort. Every other site in the repository hoists it. Now hoisted to module scope.

acted.item: samePerson in src/features/crews/CrewManagement.tsx dereferenced a nullable argument
acted.evidence: `left?.personId === right.personId && left.personType === …` was safe only because the first comparison short-circuits. Now `left?.personType`.

acted.item: CourseCode exported in src/domain/config.ts and used nowhere
acted.evidence: Not dead, unadopted: three sites wrote `keyof typeof COURSE_CONFIG` inline instead. They now use the type.

keep.item: Duplicated helpers: sortedIds in duties.ts and crewWarnings.ts, compareStudents in duties.ts and evaluations.ts, samePerson in domain and UI
keep.evidence: Homonyms, not duplicates. The two sortedIds differ in signature, ordering and return type; unifying them would change warning keys. The two compareStudents differ in tie-break. Unifying samePerson would widen a domain contract to nullable for one UI call site.

keep.verdict: KEEP 30, and the export is dead weight on 5
keep.evidence: Thirty appear in the signature of an exported function or interface, which is the export's reason to exist. Dropping `export` on TRANSCRIPTION_GUARD, speechTranscriptionProvider, studentScanProvider, StudentScanProvider and AppSchema would be cosmetic: no tool in the repository checks unused exports, and these are app modules Rollup tree-shakes anyway.

The premise that the canvas concept was rejected is wrong: the shipped editor is a merge — full-frame stage, edge handles, no slider and the exact-angle stepper come from the canvas concept, line-to-straighten from the document one. The plan's own sentence at the 2026-09-16 entry references the pair. The deleted variants gallery was six rendered PNG alternatives, a different category from 39 KB of prose recording why.

keep.item: The six OCR and speech benchmark scripts under .evidence/UG1/
keep.evidence: fetch-balanced.mjs and build-corpus.mjs take dsp.mjs by path argument; bench.mjs injects variants.js into the page; ocr-real-diagnostic.mjs is the hand-run diagnostic .gitignore line 10 exists for. None is orphaned.

keep.evidence: students.spec.ts is the only coverage anywhere of the nickname and manual phone fields; crews.spec.ts of the staff A-terra guard and the empty state; knowledge.spec.ts of the Salvataggio→Salvato transition and a reload; duties.spec.ts of the whole warning, exception, recalculation and completed-day surface; boats.spec.ts of BoatModelMark in a browser — and boats and knowledge are the only WebKit coverage of their areas, because the iphone-13-webkit-core project selects specs by filename.
